title: Exploiting GPUs for Fast Force-Directed Visualization of Large-Scale Networks
gpu_scope: GPU parallelization of the ForceAtlas2 force-directed layout algorithm with CUDA-specific memory coalescing and load balancing; 40x-123x speedup over CPU implementations.
notes: Confirmed genuine repository (govertb/GPUGraphLayout) matching this exact paper and authors; the author's own PDF filename says icpp2018 despite the paper appearing in the ICPP 2017 proceedings.
